name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle plugin: Skeleton (Release 0) -> MVP -> v1 releases; bone/flesh feature spines; cumulative product demo; bones registry. v0.1.0 ships the state engine, five of six entry skills, the execution engine and all three close ceremonies. KNOWN GAPS: the round-orchestration execution lane has no invoking entry point, and ossify is NOT marketplace-registered and ships no .codex-plugin manifest until Plan D's eval ship gate passes - so it is dogfoodable from the repo, not installable. Roadmap: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-06-ossify-release-roadmap.md
